narration: What would you do... if you found a bag full of gold, and no one was watching?
This is the story of Kwame... the honest fisherman of Oshimili.
One quiet dawn, his old net grew heavy... heavy with a pouch of gold coins.
Enough to buy ten boats. Enough to never go hungry again.
But Kwame remembered the words of his father:
A coin that is not yours... is a debt that never sleeps.
So he rowed ashore, and walked the dusty streets from hut to hut, asking everyone the same question:
At last, the village elder pointed him to Mama Zainab... an old widow whose savings had slipped into the river three moons ago.
Kwame placed the gold into her trembling hands... and the whole village fell silent.
Then... the drums of joy began to beat.
That evening, the river seemed to whisper its thanks.
His nets rose full of fish, fuller than they had ever been... and his heart, fuller still.
Honesty planted today... becomes tomorrow's harvest.
